# v0.5.2b2 — Charging waits and vehicle-aware phase switching

Beta release for the integration and optional Modbus service. **0.5.1 remains
the stable release.**

- Configure the interval between charging-state changes in seconds (default
  **300**, range **0–3600**). Early requests are queued and shown through
  **Pending change** and **Pending change due**, without per-second history writes.
- Confirm that the vehicle has paused before changing phases, with a separate
  configurable grace time (default **5 seconds**, range **0–30**). Failed
  confirmation leaves charging paused and the phase command unsent.
- Skip vehicle-related waits when fresh wallbox readings confirm no vehicle is
  connected. Five-second register-write guards and heartbeat remain active.
  Setup, control and troubleshooting documentation now describes this behavior.
- Preserve an applied queued stop across service restarts even if the next
  wallbox read fails or is cancelled.

**A stop request also waits for the configured interval** and replaces an older
pending start. Phase changes do not resume charging automatically.

## Update

Update the app from **`#apps-beta`** first, then select **0.5.2b2** in the
integration's HACS/Marketplace prerelease channel and restart Home Assistant
Core. Keep the existing app data and integration entry. The app update briefly
interrupts heartbeat and cancels pending commands; a Core restart leaves the
running service and its queue active.

The integration still accepts service **0.5.0 or newer with API 2**. The new
timing settings and pending status require **service 0.5.2b2** in service mode.
For older app connection choices and channel selection, see the
[beta update guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.5.2b2/docs/upgrading.md).
